text:
maria: kicking off onboarding for 47b-rotary-v1. weights uploaded to s3://weights/redwood/47b-rotary/v1/sha-abc123. tokenizer file is tokenizer.json but noticed odd unk token mapping — pinging runtime for quick sanity check.
ajay: thanks, will pull weights and run checksum + weightpath. can you paste the model config.yml here? need attn, rope_scale, multiquery, sliding_window.
maria: config pasted below:
```yaml
model:
  attn: rotary
  rope_scale: 1.0
  multiquery: true
  sliding_window: 1024
tokenizer:
  type: bpe
  unk_token: '<unk>'
  bos_token: '<s>'
  lower_case: false
```
sam: heads-up: runtime expects rope_scale float <= 2.0; if the model used legacy RoPE we should set rope_interpolation: linear. also note multiquery=true changes KV-cache layout -> conversion script required.
kyle: @sam can you link the conversion script? i can run it on my workstation.
sam: link: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime-scripts/convert_kv_layout.sh (run with --mq-true). also tokenizer.json lacks byte-fallback for non-utf8; add fallback_bytes: true or tests will fail on some CJK inputs.
zhen: quick test: after running conversion the model loads but failing test_attn_rotary_scale.py — mismatch at step 12 (~1e-3). suspect numeric diffs from quantization.
maria: model was exported with q4_0. we can try q4_1 or an fp16 export to isolate quantization vs numeric implementation.
ajay: i'll queue a dedicated fp16 run on dev-gpu-2 with same prompts. ETA ~25m.
lina: small note: sliding_window=1024 might be too small for our eval set (we have sequences up to ~2048). recommend 2048 or enable dynamic windowing.
maria: good catch, i'll update config to 2048 and re-upload to s3://weights/redwood/47b-rotary/v1/config.yml
ci-bot: preflight check passed: weights checksum ok, tokenizer schema valid, config lint OK (warnings: sliding_window < expected for some evals).
sam: if fp16 still mismatches, try disabling rotary scaling (rope_scale: null) to see if that narrows the diff.
ajay: fp16 run finished: load succeeded, attention mismatch reduced to ~2e-4 but still failing threshold. sample diff:
```
expected: 0.123456
actual:   0.123214
```
maria: likely quantization rounding. i've filed an export request to try q5_0 with same seed. meanwhile can we short-circuit the failing CI test to 'warn' for this model until we resolve?
kyle: i can open a PR to add a model-specific runtime override to downgrade that test to warn. assigning to myself. @maria can you create an issue with the export request + sha?
maria: done: https://issues.redwood/INF-4321 — export request created and tagged model-team.
zhen: also running a GQA vs MQA comparison. early signal: MQA reduces memory but changes KV indexing. runtime mapping must use 'mqa->kv_stride=1' for this export or outputs will misalign.
sam: noted, i'll add a unit test for kv_stride mapping to catch regressions.
maria: thanks everyone. next steps summary: ajay confirm fp16 -> q export comparisons, sam add kv tests + docs for convert_kv_layout.sh, kyle PR the test-override, maria follow up on export issue. ping here if blocked. :thumbsup:
